scope: Descriptive paired source-label agreement; not grounded correctness or a causal effect of tools.

arms.initial_text: One direct answer, initially supplied photographs, 96 output tokens.
arms.interactive_agent: Same initial photographs; tools and requests; eight turns, budget 12, 384 output tokens per call.

selection: Exactly the frozen 209 Sufficient families; no success-based filtering.

definitions.lost_no_valid_final: Direct match -> absent or invalid interactive verdict
definitions.lost_explicit_NME: Direct match -> valid Need more evidence
definitions.lost_valid_wrong_label: Direct match -> valid opposite definite label
definitions.trace_flags: Observed, potentially overlapping events; not exclusive causal attributions.
